introHtml: When you need promotional items that fit comfortably in the hand or slip neatly into a pocket, the 3 4 inch width offers a versatile sweet spot. From custom pens and keychains to branded bottle openers and carabiners, this size works well for giveaways, trade show swag, and employee appreciation gifts. Decoration options like pad printing or laser engraving allow crisp logo reproduction on the compact surface area. Whether you are ordering for a sales event or a new hire welcome kit, these products balance visibility with practicality.
